questions.question: Gap 1 of 8 — Save button visual hierarchy: apply DESIGN.md primary button style?

options.label: Apply DESIGN.md fix (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: Save gets #1d4ed8 filled + white text (primary); Reset, Cancel, Export get neutral ghost style. Closes the visual hierarchy gap exactly as DESIGN.md specifies. Implementation task T1 becomes committed.

options.label: Defer to implementation
options.description: Leave the gap named but unresolved. Engineer decides the button styles at implementation time without a spec. Risk: inconsistency with the design system or re-work after review.

questions.question: Gap 2 of 8 — Spacing: standardize to DESIGN.md 8px-base scale?

options.label: Apply DESIGN.md fix (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: sections 32px apart, field groups 24px, label-to-input 8px. Removes the 16px outlier and gives implementation a single source of truth. Implementation task T2 becomes committed.

options.label: Defer to implementation
options.description: Leave the inconsistency noted. Engineer picks spacing values during build. Risk: the 16px outlier persists and the form feels uneven at different scroll positions.

questions.question: Gap 3 of 8 — Error color contrast: apply DESIGN.md #991b1b on #fef2f2 tokens?

options.label: Apply DESIGN.md fix (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: error text uses #991b1b on #fef2f2 surface with an icon. Brings error states to WCAG AA contrast (from the current ~3:1). Implementation task T3 becomes committed.

options.label: Defer to implementation
options.description: Leave the contrast gap noted. Engineer resolves the color at build time. Risk: a shipped accessibility violation, since the current ~3:1 is below WCAG AA minimum of 4.5:1.

questions.question: Gap 4 of 8 — Typography: consolidate to two sizes per DESIGN.md (16px + 20px)?

options.label: Apply DESIGN.md fix (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: all body text, form labels, and helper text use 16px; section headings (h2) use 20px. The rogue 14px and 18px sizes are removed. Creates stronger two-level hierarchy. Task T4 committed.

options.label: Defer to implementation
options.description: Leave the three-size inconsistency noted. Engineer picks which sizes to use at build time. Risk: the 14px text may persist and fail WCAG AA body-text contrast at small size.

questions.question: Gap 5 of 8 — Motion: add DESIGN.md spinner pattern for Save pending state?

options.label: Apply DESIGN.md fix (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: on Save click, disable the button, show an inline spinner beside 'Saving…', set aria-busy=true. With reduced-motion: no spinner, text only. Success clears to 'Saved at HH:mm'. Task T5 committed.

options.label: Defer to implementation
options.description: Leave the frozen-page gap noted. Engineer designs the loading state at build time. Risk: inconsistency with the established spinner pattern and a 2-5s blank page on every save.

questions.question: Gap 6 of 8 — Export-while-dirty: specify that Export reads saved values only?

options.label: Export reads last-saved values (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: Export downloads the last-saved preferences, ignoring unsaved edits. No implicit save triggered. Unsaved-changes status persists. Matches the atomic-save philosophy already in the plan.

options.label: Export reads current (unsaved) field values
options.description: Add to plan: Export includes whatever is currently in the form fields, whether saved or not. The download reflects the user's in-progress state. Simpler to implement but may surprise users who export before saving.

options.label: Defer to implementation
options.description: Leave this scenario unspecified. Engineer decides at build time. Risk: inconsistent behavior between implementations or user confusion when exported JSON differs from what they see in the form.

questions.question: Gap 7 of 8 — Ghost button spec: reference existing component or add explicit values?

options.label: Reference existing Button component ghost variant (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: 'Reset, Cancel, Export use the existing Button component ghost variant. No new CSS values are introduced.' Clean, DRY, ties to the component system.

options.label: State explicit CSS values in the plan
options.description: Add to plan: ghost buttons have transparent background, 1px border #d1d5db, text #374151, hover background #f9fafb. Useful if the Button component doesn't yet have a ghost variant or its values are unclear.

options.label: Defer — leave ghost style unspecified
options.description: Let the engineer look up or invent ghost button values at build time. Risk: visual inconsistency with other ghost buttons in the app.

answers.Gap 7 of 8 \u2014 Ghost button spec: ref: Reference existing Button component ghost variant (recommended)

questions.question: Gap 8 of 8 — InlineStatus during validation: specify it reads 'Unsaved changes'?

options.label: Specify 'Unsaved changes' during validation (recommended)
options.description: Add to plan: when validation errors fire, InlineStatus text is 'Unsaved changes' (the normal dirty state). The live region announces once; field errors and ErrorSummary announce separately via focus. No simultaneous conflicting announcements.

options.label: Defer — leave live region coordination unspecified
options.description: Let the engineer decide what InlineStatus reads during validation. Risk: screen reader announces conflicting states simultaneously if the live region and error summary fire at the same moment.
